title: Influence bound for monotone functions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a monotone Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its total influence is at most $\sqrt{\log_2 s}$, where $s$ is the minimum number of leaves in a deterministic decision tree computing $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
